_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil is real — 0 of 54 windows saw a ±2+ score move, both brains see compressed energy with no catalyst, and forcing a directional call in this regime is how the record went 0-for-14; HOLD with conviction is the skilled call until a genuine breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both agree on HOLD direction and a Denial-adjacent current phase, but the analyst forward-calls Disbelief as the next leg up while the narrative implies we are already transitioning there; the analyst is more cautious and evidence-anchored.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding drops below 0.005% AND exchange_netflow falls below 80 with price holding $62K — signals accumulation under the surface validating a coil-to-up break into Disbelief
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC breaks below $60K with VIX spiking above 20 and funding going negative — confirms Denial was actually sliding to Panic, killing the coil read
